Symptom you see: Run aborts: "client X didn't report status for N seconds"
Cause: Slow site silent longer than the status interval
Fix: 24h timeouts — already set in the job configs

Symptom you see: NVML: Unknown Error; GPU "vanishes" mid-run (nvidia-smi on the host is fine)
Cause: A routine daemon-reload strips the GPU from running containers (systemd cgroup driver)
Fix: Run fix_docker_cgroupfs.sh once — persists across reboots

Symptom you see: Client looks healthy but never registers after a restart
Fix: Delete daemon_pid.fl in the kit root and relaunch (now cleared automatically)

Symptom you see: Instant crash: OSError: Read-only file system
Cause: ODELIA_PREPROCESS_CACHE_DIR set to a HOST path that lands under the read-only /data mount
Fix: It is a path INSIDE the container. Leave it unset — the default (/scratch/...) is already correct

Symptom you see: Run aborts: MODEL_UNRECOGNIZED from a slow site
Cause: Swarm advanced a round without the slow site

Fix: Run the VPN as the mediswarm-vpn systemd service + health-monitor timer

Symptom you see: DataLoader worker killed: Bus error / shared memory
Guard aborts with "too many unusable inputs" and lists load_error:PermissionError
Cause: The container cannot READ your image files
Fix: Fix file permissions/ownership. Do NOT delete or exclude the data — it is fine

Symptom you see: VPN service hangs asking for a password and never reconnects
Cause: GoodAccess .ovpn ships a bare auth-user-pass, so OpenVPN prompts instead of reading the credentials file
Fix: Re-run setup_vpntunnel.sh (fixed) — or point auth-user-pass at /etc/openvpn/client/mediswarm.auth

Symptom you see: Two OpenVPN tunnels running at once; connectivity is flaky
Cause: A manual tunnel left running alongside the systemd service
Fix: Keep only the mediswarm-vpn systemd service; stop and disable the other
